runtime.model_memory_query: aclmdlQuerySize is recorded for the active integrated OM; qwen35_dflash_om_inspect sums weights and uses the maximum serial workspace across a proposed multi-OM set
runtime.memory: persistent pinned host/device buffers; integrated input device mirrors upload only changed contiguous ranges after the first call and target D2H is limited to the last K+1 rows required by every current scheduler read; the multi-OM runner (five-artifact baseline or four-artifact unified Target step) uses one 64-byte-aligned prefill control carrier but uploads only the prefix through the last field consumed by each chunk, keeps the EOS tail process-resident, gives the unified topology one aligned process-resident INT32 zero-count view, accumulates contiguous Target feature slabs in one device arena, and downloads only compact scheduler-visible results
runtime.synchronization: the multi-OM runner queues every non-final 64-row prompt chunk without LM-head execution, compact D2H or host synchronization, executes the head-only graph once after the final chunk, and exposes an exact DFlash synchronization-window selector: default 1 synchronizes every verify transaction, while candidate 2 queues two complete dependent transactions, coalesces their adjacent compact slots into one contiguous D2H and uses one barrier when the remaining-token budget is safe
runtime.execution_io_evidence: runner JSON records each resident aclmdl model ID, actual/full-equivalent H2D and D2H bytes, base/count/proposal/full prefill-prefix routes, packed-control/decode/proposal copy counts, Draft verify feature input/full-equivalent/elided rows and fixed/prefix/pending routes, unified Target-step resident-zero bytes and bindings, role executions, one completion per full prompt, elided intermediate-prefill D2H/synchronizations, speculative transactions, synchronization windows, coalesced D2H calls/padding and elided speculative barriers; actual D2H calls plus coalesced calls close by transaction while stream synchronization closes by host-visible window
runtime.incremental_profile_attribution: diagnostic profile 1+1 records a preallocated ordinal/model ID/physical-row trace and analyze-msprof requires complete op_summary coverage plus exact aclmdlExecuteAsync, aclrtMemcpyAsync, aclrtMemsetAsync and aclrtSynchronizeStream counts before attributing Task Duration to role/gear; formal unprofiled 3+10 evidence disables and empties this trace
runtime.incremental_performance_candidate: framework/abi/incremental-performance-v2.json is APPROVED_IN_IMPLEMENTATION_NOT_ACTIVE; exact device-state implementation is authorized, while activation still requires export/ATC/parity/memory and same-device latency gates
runtime.incremental_transaction_tail: ExactAcceptCommitStateGraph keeps a fixed 16-row external transaction ABI with device-side longest-prefix acceptance, EOS truncation, scalar state selection and compact output; the five-artifact baseline executes physical T=16 for logical K=1..15, while the inactive unified candidate executes physical T=1 for ordinary decode and T=K+1 for verify before padding only the transaction carriers back to 16 rows
runtime.incremental_target_step_topologies: split-prefill-head-five-resident-v1 retains target-decode1; split-prefill-head-four-resident-unified-target-step-v1 removes that artifact and requires one dynamic target-verify-commit OM with every exact T=1..16 gear; both remain inactive until real AIR/ATC custom-node, zero-mismatch, memory-fit and unprofiled latency gates pass
runtime.incremental_target_step_zero_count: the unified topology initializes one aligned INT32 zero in the first full prefill-control upload and binds every T=1 dataset directly to it; T=2..16 datasets keep binding the mutable positive-K proposal carrier, so ordinary decode issues no mutable K=0 H2D and cannot force a later positive-K restore; this is a C++ buffer/view route only and does not change the AIR/OM graph ABI
runtime.incremental_state_reset_candidates: async-memset clears one Target/Draft input state set inside first-prefill timing; immutable-zero initializes one extra read-only state set at process startup and removes per-request state clears; both preserve the v2 OM ABI and require same-device memory/latency selection
runtime.incremental_prefill_completion: non-final prompt chunks keep Target state and contiguous feature slabs ordered on one stream without executing Draft; a pinned-host staging slot per maximum 64-row chunk prevents asynchronous H2D source reuse, and only the final chunk executes one prebound dynamic-gear Draft, returns compact output and synchronizes
runtime.incremental_prefill_control: one carrier with AscendCL-compliant 64-byte-aligned device subsegments keeps exactly one H2D per prompt chunk but uploads only the prefix through IDs/effective length, final-Draft total count, a changed positive proposal count, or a changed process-resident EOS table/count; the five-artifact slot is 896 bytes, while the unified slot is 960 bytes after its aligned resident zero-count segment; strict report counters close all four routes, every elided byte and every unified T=1 zero binding
runtime.incremental_prefill_head: target-prefill excludes lm_head and exports last_hidden; target-prefill-head owns only the moved QLinear/top1/EOS boundary and executes once per completed prompt, while report counters require one elision for every non-final chunk
runtime.incremental_decode_device_carrier: two compact result arenas ping-pong with Target state, and one runner binary exposes an exact same-ABI selector: one-token-h2d keeps only one-row compact results device-resident and uses pinned-host H2D after multi-token commits, while last-token-d2d keeps every last committed token device-resident, binds row zero directly and copies later rows by one 8-byte D2D into the aligned scalar; report counters close both routes, and only same-device unprofiled 3+10 zero-mismatch evidence may select the deployment default
runtime.incremental_dflash_sync_window: the same runner and unchanged AIR/OM tensor ABI expose dflash-sync-window 1 or 2; window 2 reuses the two compact ping-pong slots in one contiguous 1024-byte arena, queues two dependent Draft-to-verify transactions, downloads 512+452 bytes in one D2H call and synchronizes once when the first worst-case K0+1 commit leaves room for a second exact transaction whose K1 may shrink; two 4-byte pinned proposal-count scalar slots preserve asynchronous H2D source lifetime, the host commits results in order and stops at first EOS, and real-device unprofiled 3+10 median/p90 must beat the default window 1 before promotion
runtime.incremental_draft_feature_prefix: one unchanged Draft OM exposes verify feature N=1..16 and prompt N=64,128,... gears; fixed-16 remains the default rollback route, while committed-prefix binds accepted+1 leading rows after synchronization and the prior K+1 causal upper bound for an unsynchronized second transaction; only KV below logical_draft_cursor is authoritative, row counters and msprof trace attribution must close, and real-device zero-mismatch 3+10 evidence is required before promotion
runtime.incremental_verify_scalar_state_seed: per-linear-layer-jit-v1 keeps committed GDN state scalar at the target-verify-commit graph boundary, lets causal-conv consume scalar state directly, and seeds only the fixed 16-slot recurrent input immediately before each linear-attention layer; it preserves the GDR-MTP ABI and requires regenerated AIR/OM workspace and latency evidence
runtime.incremental_verify_cache_indices: once-per-verify-v1 derives the 16 target-block and in-block-offset values once from the logical cursor and reuses them across K/V in all eight full-attention layers; the exact source graph removes 510 repeated div/remainder and 510 repeated cast constructions while retaining all 256 single-row CacheUpdate nodes until batched update receives separate approval
runtime.incremental_device_suballocation: control, compact-result and Target/Draft state arenas reserve ALIGN_UP(payload,32)+32 bytes per segment and begin every segment at a 64-byte-aligned address

claim_boundary: Host and fake-ACL tests do not prove AIR export, OM conversion, physical 310P correctness, or latency. Those gates require the real locked target environment.
